questions.question: Explain what institutional racism is and evaluate its usefulness.
questions.correctAnswer: Institutional racism: collective failure of an organisation due to race (Macpherson). Found in police, education, CJS. Useful: explains systemic patterns without individual racist intent. Criticism: can be too vague.

questions.question: Describe the evidence for ethnic inequality in employment and crime.
questions.correctAnswer: Employment: Wood's CV study proved discrimination (74% more callbacks for White names). Crime: Black people 9x more likely to be stopped; 12% of prison vs 3% of population. Causes: discrimination, institutional racism, socio-economic factors.

questions.question: Evaluate whether legislation has effectively reduced ethnic inequality.
questions.correctAnswer: Legislation has improved formal equality but discrimination persists (CV studies, stop and search). Legislation addresses individual discrimination but not structural inequality. Conclusion: necessary but not sufficient.
